limitations: Agent-authored source-backed judgments require independent Korean-language review; this is not a precision benchmark.
Short forms preserve reported, surprise and tattling senses without selecting a contextual meaning or inserting implicit 하다.
Only source-reviewed polite 요 is added as an outer particle for this family; other outer particles remain unreviewed.
Existential and negative auxiliary paradigms remain COV-019h; derived nominal/copular interactions remain COV-020.
Frozen grouped-match totals are unchanged. Candidate means change in every partition; GSD dev 짠대 gains one recovered lemma but not its full annotated 짜다 + 대 group.

Novel additions include ambiguous 오래/노래/그래/아래/몰래 and nominal/copular hypotheses; these are not contextual accuracy gains. 그럴진대 also gains 그러다/그르다 + 어 + 를 + 지다 + 는대 hypotheses, retained in the unjudged derived-boundary queue.
Training spelling/segmentation neighbors 먹어야대요, 곳인대, 물어봤는대, 갔는대, 바래요 and intention ㄹ래 are not relabeled as short-report gold. Only 쓴대요 and 한대요 are direct newly matched training targets.

release_performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
